query: Eight Beds, One of You {flag(rounds_secret): Sister Amaranth still can't stand, and is still giving orders from her chair.|The village healers are run off their feet, and Sister Amaranth, propped up in her chair, is giving them orders too.} Eight beds, eight remedies, one of you. A second-year with a burned hand wants to know if it will scar. Do every bed properly Every bed, every spoon, every charm on the hour. The burned hand won't scar. At midnight the chair says, "Bed three. Well done," and then you hear her fall asleep sitting up. You mix up beds three and five. Nobody notices but her. She makes you recite every dose on the ward back to her, with your eyes shut, before she lets you sleep. Do the urgent ones, then revise You see to the burns and the fevers and leave the rest for the morning. From the chair comes a small, disappointed silence.
